title: Midnight feature page kit picker: pick a niche kit and see Spotlight, Space and Website change together
detail: Follow-up to LIVE-1380 from the design's Templates page. A 'Pick a kit' section on /themes/midnight: six buttons, one per Midnight niche kit, and three cards (Spotlight, Space, Website) that show the chosen kit's headline and pages. Choices are computed on the server from lib/sites/kits/midnight-variants.ts and passed as plain data to components/frequency/site/pages/themes/midnight-kit-picker.tsx, so no kit code reaches the browser.
